analytics_summary_template: ${{ data.revenue|round|int }} from {{ data.orders }} orders in the {{ data.period|replace('_', ' ') }}. Top seller: {{ data.bestsellers[0].name }}.
analytics_highlights_template: [{% for p in data.bestsellers[:limit] %}{"label": {{ (p.name + " — " + p.units|string + " sold")|tojson }}, "url": {{ ("https://roast.example.com/products/" + p.handle)|tojson }}}{% if not loop.last %},{% endif %}{% endfor %}]
brand_description: Roast & Co. is an online specialty-coffee roaster: small-batch single-origin beans and blends, roasted to order and shipped fresh, with brewing guides for every method.
agent_goal: Reach new coffee drinkers through helpful guides on other platforms and turn them into first-time buyers.
